Location: Lake Rapel   Region: O'Higgins   Classification: Resolved.
The case of an anomaly associated with photographs taken by a user in the
Summary:
Early morning of March 9, 2018 from the shore of Lake Rapel, VI region.

She described it as three-dimensional, cone-shaped, and fluorescent green in color, approximately 30 km away from its location. She stated that it had not moved and associated it with the opening of a portal that had to appear for milliseconds, making it imperceptible to the human eye.

The authenticity of the images was verified through analysis of their metadata.

The images corresponded to the date and time they were declared to have been taken.

The photographs were taken by a Canon EOS REBEL T5 machine with a Canon EF-S 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6 III lens, at an aperture of 27 mm, manual exposure at 1/181 s, f/4, and with an equivalent sensitivity to ISO 100.

Investigation:

The phenomenon did not form an image in the focal plane, maintaining its sharpness despite

Due to the differences in focus depth of the various shots in which it appears.

It was not seen in shot 6995, for which the camera was rotated, leaving behind the nearby light sources that were in front and to the right of the machine. On the other hand, the lighting of the branches corresponded to light emitted by the green lights in the vicinity.

The technical analysis of the images allowed to determine that the alterations detected corresponded to the effect of the incidence of parasitic lights on the camera's optical system and that they came from light sources present on the side of the focus of the photographed scenes.
